definition: Collection, reuse, refurbishment, recycling or environmentally sound disposal of end-of-life electrical and electronic equipment and its batteries, and the plans, rules and capacity that govern it. Includes take-back schemes, decommissioning and disposal of replaced equipment, e-waste management plans and protocols, extended producer responsibility, e-waste strategy and regulation, and recycling or refurbishment facilities. Excludes general municipal solid, medical or chemical waste, and procurement of new equipment without an end-of-life arrangement. Buying efficient equipment is energy_efficiency.
